messages:
Noah Kim: Quick thread: Cloud partner (HelioCloud) proposed a graduated rebate private-offer: commit bands that unlock rebates over quarters + an onboarding migration credit. Need cross-functional signoff on mechanics and renewal language.
Elena Brooks: can you paste the core proposal? curious about timing and caps.
Ravi Singh: key bits from partner: commit tiers quarterly (Q1-Q4), rebates paid at quarter end if usage >= committed %; one-time migration credit if they convert within 60 days of listing.
Marta (Finance): red flags: rebate payout timing affects revenue recognition. prefer rebates applied as contra-revenue at payout. also want a per-customer cap and a partner-level exposure cap. propose cap = min($150k, 10% of committed ARR).
Sam (Legal): need explicit renewal waterfall. example language we usually put in private-offers: "Year1: 20% rebate, Year2: 12% rebate, Year3: 8% rebate (auto-step-down)". also include audit rights for usage verification and an embargo clause for public pricing.
Noah Kim: ops question: partner wants rebates to be auto-evaluated by our billing engine. is that doable?
Ravi Singh: yes if partner provides signed usage feed and we have mapping tokens. ops flow:
```
1) partner uploads mapping CSV + signed SOW
2) eng-ops issues temp SKU token
3) usage tagged with token
4) end-of-quarter reconciliation job computes rebates
5) finance issues contra-revenue adjustment / rebate payment
```
Marta (Finance): need 30-day reconciliation window post-quarter and invoice-level audit logs. also require marketplace take accounted for before rebate calc (i.e., rebate on net after marketplace fee).
Sam (Legal): include appendix: SKU mapping & 60-day deprecation notice. require partner to accept audit logs and dispute window (45 days). also cap cumulative credits per customer.
Elena Brooks: marketing asks: partner wants co-announcement for high-tier customers early. Legal, can we permit private customer references pre-list under NDA?
Sam (Legal): yes with NDA + explicit script approval. no published pricing before listing.
Noah Kim: on migration credit: propose one-time credit code applied on first post-conversion invoice, expires 60 days, capped per customer and global. Ops to automate code issuance.
Ravi Singh: will draft mapping CSV example and token flow spec.
Marta (Finance): I'll model the rebate impact with proposed cap and marketplace fee and share numbers by EOD.
Sam (Legal): I'll draft T&Cs with renewal waterfall, audit clause, embargo, and appendix. circulate redlines tomorrow morning.
OpsBot: Task created: marketplace-rebate/3467890123 (assignee: eng-ops). reminder set for reconciliation run at 3467966523.
Noah Kim: thanks team  action items noted: Ravi mapping + token spec, Marta model cap, Sam draft T&Cs, Elena coordinate partner comms. reconvene 11am PT tomorrow.
